I've been thinking a lot about my experience and decided that I should write a review.

I employed Marley's Misfits for boarding training in late June. I had just moved into my apartment, and my dog was having trouble with reacting to other dogs in the building, especially when caught off guard on the elevator. I asked them to take my dog while I was out of town to work on this specific problem. My dog is 5 years old, and otherwise trained and housebroken.

The whole process felt very unofficial and unprofessional. I mostly just texted with someone to set it up, and there wasn't any agreement or contract to sign before handing my dog over. He also asked me which kind of shock collar I was comfortable with him using, and when I said no to using one, he told me that his training wouldn't be effective without them. My dog is VERY food motivated, I didn't see a need for a shock collar.

The boarding training costed me $2400 for 14 days, and I don't think I got what I paid for. The trainer told me that my dog was neutral around other dogs, which isn't the case. I did not get the sense that he focused any real time on training out her reaction to dogs that catch her off guard. He did not provide any account on what was worked on, or any real guidance on how to continue the training at home.

Lastly, when my dog was returned to me, she was in rough shape. She was extremely thirsty and drank 3 full bowls of water one after the other. She had poop crusted all over her butt and clearly had not been cleaned for several days. She (and the bag I provided with treats and blankets) smelled really really bad. I was worried for a few days after that she was not properly attended to over the 14 days.

I just thought I would write about my experience with boarding training. From the reviews, it seems like the regular training sessions are probably worth it/fine. However, from my experience I wouldn't recommend the boarding training.

We had an excellent experience working with Joseph at Marley’s Misfit Dogs and would highly recommend him. We are first-time dog owners with a very energetic Double Doodle puppy and came to Joseph with quite a list of things we needed help with — biting, jumping, leash pulling, barking for attention, recall, place/stay, stair confidence and general puppy manners.

Joseph was fantastic with our puppy from the beginning. He is knowledgeable, patient and incredibly good at understanding dog behaviour, but just as importantly, he taught us how to work with our dog. He gave us practical techniques that we could actually use at home and helped us understand why certain behaviours were happening and how to respond consistently.

The difference has been huge. The issues we originally contacted Marley’s about have been resolved, and we feel so much more confident as dog owners. Our puppy has grown into a much better-mannered dog, and we learned a tremendous amount along the way.

Joseph was a pleasure to work with, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for a great dog trainer.

We rescued our dog Bailey in Oct 2025. She is our first rescue and we were not quite sure what to expect. As she came out of her shell, we had issues with jumping (at people/bags/buggies/cars); barking (at people and dogs); resource guarding; and general listening.
Joseph helped us understand and work with Bailey. We have had tremendous success, and have been able to correct all safety and socializing issues; and Bailey is happier now that we can understand her a little bit better.

We will definitely recommend Marley's Misfits to anyone seeking personalized and patient help with their pups!

When I first came to Joseph and Kayla I was at my wit's end.  I had a 100lb 14 month old husky-rottweiler that was chomping on me several times a day.  I had been working with a trainer that was only positive reinforcement that wasn't working.  His daily tantrums were only rewarded with jackpots of treats and getting worse every week.  He's a smart dog, and learned all sorts of tricks, but his aggressive behaviour to me was a huge problem and he was anxious all the time as well.  At the time I kept thinking it was just standard puppy mouthing, it would stop when he got neutered and all the testosterone was out of his system.  That was not the case.
My initial chat with Kayla on the phone was so reassuring as they knew immediately what to do.  He was exhibiting classic Rottweiler behaviour - he is extremely dominant and has a strong guarding instinct. We signed up for a 9 weeks of intense training, and his behaviour has been night and day ever since.  Honestly, the methods were uncomfortable at first (they're really just training YOU), but the results have been astounding.  At the end of the program I was impressed as the aggressive behaviour towards me was almost completely gone and for the first time it felt like I had a normal dog.  I won't say he was perfect, but we had reined him in, and he was making visible positive behavioural improvements on a weekly basis.  Anytime we had a problematic situation come up, Joseph and Kayla always responded timely with a text with what to do.
Since finishing the program, we've reintegrated him to the dog park and he has all sorts of dog friends.  We've been focusing on calming him down the last few months and it's been wonderful as his anxiety has reduced immensely.  We can trust him to cuddle on the couch with us, and I can comfortably walk him off leash or at the park knowing that he can recall at any time.  A year ago I could not have imagined this was possible and I am grateful to Joseph and Kayla from the bottom of my heart.

We rescued a dog named Toboggan (Toby) a few months ago, and he came to us absolutely terrified of everything and everyone. We wanted him to learn that not all humans are bad and he deserves love. Joseph was so amazing with us since our first session. He really took the time to get to know our dog and our family, and identified the priorities for Toby's training. He worked with us very closely through Toby's progress and we appreciated his honesty and realistic expectations. His methods worked very well for us and Toby has settled in so nicely! He went from yanking us all over the place to walking so nicely and listening to us (and he is 70 lbs so he is a strong boy!). We are so proud of Toby's accomplishments, and thankful to Joseph for getting us there! We are also thankful to Kayla who is super nice and very accommodating when we had to reschedule a few of our sessions. She does everything she can to make things work out! We look forward to booking some more serious sessions with Toby in the future, now that he's mastered the foundation training. :)

I’m just over half way through my puppy training time with Joseph and could not be happier. I found Marley’s Misfits while searching through many trainers to help me with dealing with an English bulldog who was very fearful of Toronto city noise. The difference is night and day and I’m so grateful for the support Marley’s Misfits has offered. Most people I meet can’t even believe my puppy is 5 months old because she’s so well adjusted and behaved (she’s still a brat at home sometimes, but hey, she’s a puppy!). Thank you Joseph and Kayla, I’m beyond appreciative of your help and look forward to helping Nova grow even more.

My wife and I were completely satisfied with the professionalism of both Kayla and Joseph.  They were both fantastic.  We are really happy with the results that we had with our puppy Charlie.  They did a great job.  They were extremely helpful and addressed any issues that we had.  We recommend them highly to anyone looking for some excellent training for their dogs.

Thank you,  Kayla and Joseph,  from Sandra,  Peter  and puppy  Charlie.

Joseph is a GREAT dog trainer — my little dog Leia loves him, just like all the other dogs do. He’s literally like the dog whisperer. He taught us so much about how to manage our dog in every way. He pays close attention to every detail of the dogs’ behaviour, and that’s very important. 100% recommended!

Some dogs don’t need to change. They just need to be understood.
Mine was one of them.

He wasn’t aggressive by nature. He was scared, misunderstood, and cornered by the world.
Without Kayla and Joseph, my dog would have ended up in a shelter—or worse.
It’s not dramatic. It’s just the truth. He bit us. More than once.

Kayla and Joseph didn’t just help us. They saved his life.
They boarded him for weeks, cared for him like he was their own, and never made it about the money.
They don’t just train dogs. They show up when it matters most.

I’ve read the reviews debating prong collars and tools. But mercy without structure can lead to pain—for the dog, and for the people trying to love them.
Kayla and Joseph taught us that structure is kindness too.

My dog has always been a gentle soul. He just needed someone to help him be seen.
And I needed to become someone worth following.

Kayla and Joseph didn’t just change our path. They gave us one.

Joseph and Kayla gave me the tools to use to train my dogs and the difference in their behaviour is remarkable! I also brought my new puppy back for her puppy training classes and it equally as wonderful. I’m so happy you related closer timo me, looking forward to group classes in the summer! Thank you guys so much!
